designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized the Interior Secretary to acquire a wetland tract in Prince William County, Virginia, that became Featherstone National Wildlife Refuge.
designationHistory.note: FWS sources conflict and none is independent. The CCP says Public Law 91-499 was approved October 22, 1970, but its purposes appendix gives 'Date Established: 23 February 1970', and its narrative says the land was first acquired from the District of Columbia in 1979; the FWS web page says the land was acquired in 1970. The statute text was not read.
